intent: Individually authored tasks preserve disaster reports, almost versus completely empty, practice versus occurrence, boat effects, inland instructions and limited rescue outcomes.

transfer.stem: Which notes match the pond photograph, the boat report and the warning?
transfer.passage:
Reading the weather reports
For our class newspaper, we compared reports from different places. One photograph showed floodwater reaching the steps of a library. Another showed a village pond left almost empty by drought. We read each caption before writing our own.
Two storm reports described different effects: a typhoon damaged trees along the coast, while a hurricane forced boats to stay in port. A separate report quoted a tsunami warning that told people to move inland.
At school, we also practised what to do during an earthquake. Before the exercise, our teacher reminded us to keep the emergency exit clear at all times. Afterwards, we read about a rescue team that had used a boat to reach a family.

options.text: The pond had very little water left; the boats had to stay in port; the warning told people to move inland.
The pond had no water left at all; the boats had to stay in port; the warning told people to move inland.
The pond had very little water left; the boats had to sail out to sea; the warning told people to move inland.
The pond had very little water left; the boats had to stay in port; the warning told people to move towards the sea.

answer.display: The pond had very little water left; the boats had to stay in port; the warning told people to move inland.

explanation.strategy: 分别核对almost的程度、被迫留港的结果与inland的方向。

steps.text: 警报要求move inland，方向是内陆。
steps.reason: inland与朝海面相反；警报中的要求也不等于人人已经完成转移。

distractors.reason: 把almost empty扩大成完全没有水。
把被迫留港反转成被迫出海。
把向内陆反转成朝海面。
